title: Local session changes discard all app view memos
detail: When a local agent on a reverse outpost emits an ordinary state change, the updated AppMachine session Arc is included in equality at native/crates/attn-app/src/lib.rs:268. The app treats it like a machine identity change and discards all view memos. The independent reviewer observed five sidebar row builds after one machine-link state-only event in a scratch wire probe. Limit full invalidation to a change of the app machine ID or home, and keep ordinary local facts on the existing memo-version paths.
